readout_other: single-pulse TMS MEPs from FDI; resting-state EEG frontocentral gamma power; motor sequence learning task (micro-online and micro-offline gains)
direction_notes: M1 TUS reduced MEP amplitude for at least 30 min and hippocampal TUS reduced frontocentral gamma power; hippocampal TUS shifted motor-sequence gains from offline (rest) to online (practice).

exposures.label: Hippocampal TUS (posterior hippocampus contralateral to task hand)

timing.protocol_description: 20-ms ultrasound bursts delivered at 5 Hz for 80 s (400 bursts total), corresponding to a 10% duty cycle; delivered once before the motor sequence task.

flags.reason: 35 W/cm2 is a 'target' Isppa for which peak pressure was measured in a water tank (1.03 MPa); mean delivered Isppa across participants was 35.9 +/- 7.7 W/cm2.
Simulated in situ mean (0.36 +/- 0.003 MPa) across participants, from k-Plan simulations on pseudo-CT.
Paper states all sonication parameters were identical between M1 and hippocampal protocols; values copied from the single protocol description.
No pressure or intensity stated for the M1 experiment.
'20-ms bursts at 5 Hz, 10% duty cycle': 20 ms matches duty cycle / PRF, so burst taken as the pulse.
72 includes sham participants; cohorts overlap partly across experiments (52 original plus 20 replication).
Blinding not mentioned in the text.
